services.name: Karaoke Night
services.desc: We are opening up our lobby for a free, community karaoke night…and everyone is invited! Join us for an evening of music, laughter, and bold (or beautifully off-key) performances. Bring your favorite song, bring your friends, and enjoy a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere in our new home at The Joan in Arts District Liberty Station. Our concessions bar will be open with drinks and snacks available for purchase, so you can sip and sing. Come to perform or come to cheer. Either way, it’s a night of music, connection, and a little theatrical flair. Cygnet Theatre, is a 501-3c tax exempt nonprofit organization.
